blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 13\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qism ka sawal hai: yeh quadratic function hai aur \(a = 1\) positive hai, is liye parabola ooper ki taraf khulta hai (U-shape). Aisi shakal ka sab se neecha point hota hai, yani minimum value, maximum nahin.
Humein woh minimum value aur woh \(x\) find karna hai jahan yeh milti hai.
Plan: completing square (mukammal murabba bana kar) \(f(x) = (x - h)^2 + k\) likhenge; phir minimum \(k\) hoga jo \(x = h\) par milega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 13\), yani \(a = 1\), \(b = 6\), \(c = 13\).
Humein find karna hai: minimum (ya maximum) value aur woh \(x\) jahan yeh hoti hai.
Tareeqa: completing square. Kisi bhi number ka square kabhi negative nahin hota, is liye jab function \((x - h)^2 + k\) ki shakal mein aa jaye to sab se chhoti value foran nazar aa jati hai.

(6 ka aadha)\(^2\) jama bhi karein aur minus bhi
\[f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 9 - 9 + 13\]
Kyun: \(x\) ke coefficient 6 ka aadha 3 hai aur \(3^2 = 9\). 9 jama karne se \(x^2 + 6x + 9\) aik perfect square ban jata hai. Saath hi 9 minus bhi kar diya, taa ke \(f(x)\) ki value bilkul na badle. Yeh aisa hai jaise jeb mein 9 rupay daal kar foran nikaal liye: kul raqam wahi rahi.

Perfect square likhein aur constants jor dein
\[f(x) = (x + 3)^2 - 9 + 13\]
\[f(x) = (x + 3)^2 + 4\]
Kyun: \(x^2 + 6x + 9 = (x + 3)^2\) hai (khud multiply kar ke dekh lein: \((x+3)(x+3)\)). Bache hue numbers \(-9 + 13 = 4\).

Minimum value parhein
\[(x + 3)^2 \ge 0 \Rightarrow f(x) \ge 4\]
Kyun: \((x + 3)^2\) sab se chhota tab hota hai jab yeh zero ho, yani \(x + 3 = 0\), \(x = -3\). Us waqt \(f(-3) = 0 + 4 = 4\). Kisi aur \(x\) par square positive hoga, is liye \(f(x)\) 4 se bara hoga. Chunke \(a > 0\) hai, parabola ooper ja kar kabhi nahin rukta, is liye maximum value koi nahin.
Dhyan dein: \((x + 3)^2\) zero hone ke liye \(x = -3\) chahiye, \(+3\) nahin. Bracket ke andar wala sign ulat kar \(x\) milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-3) = 9 - 18 + 13 = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function mein \(x = -3\) rakhne se bhi 4 hi aaya, matlab hamara completing square bilkul theek tha.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum value \(= 4\), jo \(x = -3\) par milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = x^2 + 4x\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi \(a = 1 > 0\) hai, parabola ooper khulta hai, is liye function ki minimum value hogi.
Is mein constant term nahin hai (\(c = 0\)), lekin tareeqa bilkul wahi hai; ghabrane ki zaroorat nahin.
Plan: completing square se \((x - h)^2 + k\) banayenge aur minimum \(k\) ko \(x = h\) par parhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 + 4x\), yani \(a = 1\), \(b = 4\), \(c = 0\).
Humein find karna hai: minimum value aur uski jagah (\(x\)).
Tareeqa: completing square. Pichle hisse wala hi qaida: \(x\) ke coefficient ka aadha le kar us ka square jama bhi karein aur minus bhi.

(4 ka aadha)\(^2\) jama aur minus karein
\[f(x) = x^2 + 4x + 4 - 4\]
Kyun: 4 ka aadha 2 hai aur \(2^2 = 4\). Aik hi number jama aur minus karne se function ki value nahin badalti, sirf shakal badalti hai jo humein chahiye.

Perfect square likhein
\[f(x) = (x + 2)^2 - 4\]
Kyun: \(x^2 + 4x + 4 = (x + 2)^2\). Ab function "square + number" ki shakal mein hai.

Minimum value parhein
\[(x + 2)^2 \ge 0 \Rightarrow f(x) \ge -4\]
Kyun: square sirf \(x = -2\) par zero hota hai; wahan \(f(-2) = -4\). Baqi har jagah square positive hai, to \(f(x) > -4\). Is liye \(-4\) sab se kam value hai.
Dhyan dein: minimum value negative bhi ho sakti hai; "minimum" ka matlab sirf "sab se chhoti value" hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-2) = 4 - 8 = -4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function mein \(x = -2\) rakhne se bhi \(-4\) aaya, to jawab pakka hai.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum value \(= -4\), jo \(x = -2\) par milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = -x^2 + 8x + 13\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(a = -1\) negative hai, is liye parabola neeche ki taraf khulta hai (ulta U). Aisi shakal ka sab se ooncha point hota hai, yani maximum value.
Humein maximum value aur uski jagah find karni hai.
Plan: pehle \(x\) wale terms se \(-1\) common lenge, phir bracket ke andar completing square karenge, aur \(f(x) = -(x - h)^2 + k\) likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -x^2 + 8x + 13\), yani \(a = -1\), \(b = 8\), \(c = 13\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum value aur woh \(x\) jahan yeh hoti hai.
Tareeqa: completing square. Square banane ke liye \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 hona chahiye, is liye pehle \(-1\) common lenge.

\(x\) wale terms se \(-1\) common lein
\[f(x) = -(x^2 - 8x) + 13\]
Kyun: \(-(x^2 - 8x) = -x^2 + 8x\) hai, yani asal terms wapas mil jate hain. Ab bracket ke andar \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-1\) common lete waqt \(+8x\) bracket mein \(-8x\) ban jata hai; yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

Bracket ke andar completing square
\[f(x) = -(x^2 - 8x + 16 - 16) + 13\]
Kyun: \(-8\) ka aadha \(-4\) hai aur \((-4)^2 = 16\). Andar 16 jama aur minus kiya, to kuch nahin badla.

\(-16\) ko bracket se bahar nikaalein
\[f(x) = -(x - 4)^2 + 16 + 13\]
\[f(x) = -(x - 4)^2 + 29\]
Kyun: andar wala \(-16\) bahar ke \(-1\) se multiply hota hai, \((-1)(-16) = +16\). Is liye bahar \(+16\) aata hai, \(-16\) nahin.

Maximum value parhein
\[-(x - 4)^2 \le 0 \Rightarrow f(x) \le 29\]
Kyun: \((x - 4)^2\) kabhi negative nahin, is liye \(-(x - 4)^2\) kabhi positive nahin. Yeh zero sirf \(x = 4\) par hota hai, aur tab function sab se bara, yani 29 hota hai. Kisi aur \(x\) par 29 mein se kuch minus ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(4) = -16 + 32 + 13 = 29 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function mein \(x = 4\) rakhne se bhi 29 aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum value \(= 29\), jo \(x = 4\) par milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = -x^2 - 3x - 5\).
blocks.explanation:
\(a = -1 < 0\) hai, parabola neeche khulta hai, is liye maximum value hogi.
\(x\) ka coefficient 3 odd hai, is liye fractions aayengi; ghabrayein nahin, bas aaram se hisaab karein.
Plan: \(-1\) common lein, \((\tfrac{3}{2})^2 = \tfrac{9}{4}\) se completing square karein, phir maximum parhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -x^2 - 3x - 5\), yani \(a = -1\), \(b = -3\), \(c = -5\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum value aur uski jagah.
Tareeqa: \(-1\) common le kar completing square.

\(x\) wale terms se \(-1\) common lein
\[f(x) = -(x^2 + 3x) - 5\]
Kyun: \(-(x^2 + 3x) = -x^2 - 3x\). Ab bracket \(x^2\) se shuru hota hai jis ka coefficient 1 hai. Constant \(-5\) bahar hi rehta hai.

Andar completing square
\[f(x) = -\left(x^2 + 3x + \tfrac{9}{4} - \tfrac{9}{4}\right) - 5\]
Kyun: 3 ka aadha \(\tfrac{3}{2}\) hai aur \((\tfrac{3}{2})^2 = \tfrac{9}{4}\). Decimal mein 1.5 aur 2.25, lekin fraction mein kaam karna zyada saaf rehta hai.

\(-\tfrac{9}{4}\) bahar nikaalein aur simplify karein
\[f(x) = -\left(x + \tfrac{3}{2}\right)^2 + \tfrac{9}{4} - 5\]
\[f(x) = -\left(x + \tfrac{3}{2}\right)^2 - \tfrac{11}{4}\]
Kyun: \((-1)(-\tfrac{9}{4}) = +\tfrac{9}{4}\). Phir 5 ko \(\tfrac{20}{4}\) likh kar \(\tfrac{9}{4} - \tfrac{20}{4} = -\tfrac{11}{4}\).

Maximum value parhein
\[f(x) \le -\tfrac{11}{4}\]
Kyun: \(-(x + \tfrac{3}{2})^2\) kabhi positive nahin hota aur \(x = -\tfrac{3}{2}\) par zero hota hai. Is liye function ki sab se bari value \(-\tfrac{11}{4}\) hai. Haan, maximum negative bhi ho sakta hai: is ka matlab hai poora parabola x-axis ke neeche hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(-\tfrac{3}{2}\right) = -\tfrac{9}{4} + \tfrac{9}{2} - 5\]
\[= \tfrac{-9 + 18 - 20}{4} = -\tfrac{11}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function se bhi wahi value aayi. Common denominator 4 le kar jama karna sab se aasaan raasta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum value \(= -\tfrac{11}{4}\), jo \(x = -\tfrac{3}{2}\) par milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = 3x^2 + 6x - 13\).
blocks.explanation:
\(a = 3 > 0\) hai, parabola ooper khulta hai, is liye minimum value hogi.
Yahan \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 nahin balke 3 hai, is liye pehle \(x\) wale terms se 3 common lena zaroori hai.
Plan: \(f(x) = 3(x^2 + 2x) - 13\), andar completing square, phir minimum parhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x^2 + 6x - 13\), yani \(a = 3\), \(b = 6\), \(c = -13\).
Humein find karna hai: minimum value aur uski jagah.
Tareeqa: \(a = 3\) common le kar completing square.

\(x\) wale terms se 3 common lein
\[f(x) = 3(x^2 + 2x) - 13\]
Kyun: \(3x^2 + 6x = 3(x^2 + 2x)\). Sirf \(x\) wale terms andar jate hain; \(-13\) ko bahar hi rehne dein, warna use bhi 3 se divide karna parega aur hisaab lamba ho jayega.

Andar completing square
\[f(x) = 3(x^2 + 2x + 1 - 1) - 13\]
Kyun: 2 ka aadha 1 hai aur \(1^2 = 1\).

\(-1\) bahar nikaalein aur simplify karein
\[f(x) = 3(x + 1)^2 - 3 - 13\]
\[f(x) = 3(x + 1)^2 - 16\]
Kyun: andar wala \(-1\) bahar ke 3 se multiply ho kar \(-3\) banta hai.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students yahan sirf \(-1\) bahar le aate hain aur jawab \(-14\) likh dete hain. Bahar ka multiplier (3) kabhi na bhoolein.

Minimum value parhein
\[3(x + 1)^2 \ge 0 \Rightarrow f(x) \ge -16\]
Kyun: square \(x = -1\) par zero hai, wahan \(f(-1) = -16\); baqi har jagah \(f(x) > -16\). Yaad rakhein: \(a\) ka sign batata hai ke minimum hai ya maximum (positive = minimum, negative = maximum), lekin \(a\) ki value (yahan 3) sirf parabola ko patla ya chaura karti hai, minimum ki jagah nahin badalti.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-1) = 3 - 6 - 13 = -16 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function mein \(x = -1\) rakhne se bhi \(-16\) aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum value \(= -16\), jo \(x = -1\) par milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Find the maximum or minimum value of the following quadratic function by completing square: \(f(x) = -2x^2 - x + 21\).
blocks.explanation:
\(a = -2 < 0\) hai, parabola neeche khulta hai, is liye maximum value hogi.
\(x\) wale terms se \(-2\) common lenge; is se andar \(x\) ka coefficient \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) ban jayega, yani fractions aayengi.
Plan: \(f(x) = -2(x^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}x) + 21\), phir \((\tfrac{1}{4})^2 = \tfrac{1}{16}\) se completing square, phir maximum parhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -2x^2 - x + 21\), yani \(a = -2\), \(b = -1\), \(c = 21\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum value aur uski jagah.
Tareeqa: \(a = -2\) common le kar completing square.

\(x\) wale terms se \(-2\) common lein
\[f(x) = -2\left(x^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}x\right) + 21\]
Kyun: \(-x\) ko \(-2\) se divide karein to \(+\tfrac{1}{2}x\) milta hai. Check: \(-2 \times \tfrac{1}{2}x = -x\), yani asal term wapas aa gaya.

Andar completing square
\[f(x) = -2\left(x^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}x + \tfrac{1}{16} - \tfrac{1}{16}\right) + 21\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) ka aadha \(\tfrac{1}{4}\) hai aur \((\tfrac{1}{4})^2 = \tfrac{1}{16}\).

\(-\tfrac{1}{16}\) bahar nikaalein aur simplify karein
\[f(x) = -2\left(x + \tfrac{1}{4}\right)^2 + \tfrac{2}{16} + 21\]
\[f(x) = -2\left(x + \tfrac{1}{4}\right)^2 + \tfrac{169}{8}\]
Kyun: \((-2)(-\tfrac{1}{16}) = \tfrac{2}{16} = \tfrac{1}{8}\). Phir 21 ko \(\tfrac{168}{8}\) likh kar \(\tfrac{1}{8} + \tfrac{168}{8} = \tfrac{169}{8}\).

Maximum value parhein
\[f(x) \le \tfrac{169}{8}\]
Kyun: \(-2(x + \tfrac{1}{4})^2\) kabhi positive nahin hota aur \(x = -\tfrac{1}{4}\) par zero hota hai. Is liye sab se bari value \(\tfrac{169}{8}\) hai, yani decimal mein 21.125. Exam mein jawab fraction \(\tfrac{169}{8}\) hi likhein; decimal sirf andaza lagane ke liye hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f\left(-\tfrac{1}{4}\right) = -\tfrac{2}{16} + \tfrac{1}{4} + 21\]
\[= -\tfrac{1}{8} + \tfrac{2}{8} + 21 = \tfrac{169}{8} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: asal function mein rakhne se bhi \(\tfrac{169}{8}\) aaya. Yaad rahe: \((-\tfrac{1}{4})^2 = \tfrac{1}{16}\) positive hai, phir \(-2\) se multiply ho kar \(-\tfrac{1}{8}\) banta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Maximum value \(= \tfrac{169}{8}\), jo \(x = -\tfrac{1}{4}\) par milti hai.
